verdict.rationale: Drafting a follow-up email is a fair question for a meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents post-meeting notes, action items, customized summaries, and AskFred Q&A over transcripts, plus an MCP tool that shares transcripts by email. None of these documents a drafted follow-up email the user can review and send. They are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
